notes.title: Ultimate Trials - Major Game Update
notes.content:
The Ultimate Trials Are Here!

Brace yourselves for the ultimate test of grit and determination! The Ultimate Trials will push you to your limits with extreme hardcore difficulty levels. Get ready to sweat as you tackle challenges that will separate the pros from the amateurs.


New game mode added - Ultimate Trials
20 Ultimate Trials levels
20 New Leaderboards
3 New Achievements 


See you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Ultimate Trials - New Update Coming Soon
notes.content: Brace yourselves for the ultimate test of grit and determination! Our upcoming update to Aim Expert will push you to your limits with extreme hardcore difficulty levels.
